The climate in Albena

Albena is about 23 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 0°C. Around 610 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 86 mm). The highest temperature in Albena in 2015–2024 was 38°C (18 July 2024) and the lowest −14°C (9 January 2017).

Albena is a resort on the northern Black Sea coast, between Balchik and Golden Sands, with a wide beach and shallow water that warms up quickly. Summers are sunny and a little cooler than in the south, and the beach season usually runs from June to mid-September.

Best time to visit Albena

The most pleasant weather in Albena is usually in June and September: average highs are between 25°C and 26°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month.
